name: Writer and a face from a photo
about: Like «Writer», but with «Keep the face from the photo»: the expanded new scenes are shot by Ref2VA with the hero's photo.

data.text:
Writer and a face from a photo.

The hero's photo — frontal, face close up, even light, neutral background: Ref2VA also pulls the surroundings from the picture. «Describe from photo», type in the idea, «Write» and «Expand into scenes» — the new scenes get the photo in their «faces» input.
